annotations.title: Read one card's price series, sales and asks

description: Read one exact Magic printing and finish. Pass treatmentAsks with foil for an etched or special-treatment snapshot. asksTcgplayerProductId identifies its source product. series holds daily stored TCGplayer Market and Low (tcgLow). buckets holds NM/LP sales with English or unspecified language, the exact raw bucketStartDate values, units, transactions, weighted market and recorded low/high. The source response does not establish each bucket's duration or end date. Use bucketsState and bucketsCoverage to see what was captured. asks contains the most recent unexpired TCGplayer snapshot for that finish with item price, condition, language and listing shipping. Use stockQuantity for provider stock. Null or absent means unknown. The legacy quantity can default to 1. printing and listingId preserve provider finish and row identity when available. Read the capture time for each source and asksExpiresAt, asksTotal, asksTruncated and limitations before using the snapshot. Find the printing with spellbook_printings_search. tcgplayerBuyUrl is an affiliate link for the standard Desk product.

cardId.description: The exact Magic printing id (a Scryfall UUID) from spellbook_printings_search. Required.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

finish.description: Which finish to read. Omit for nonfoil. Pass foil for a foil copy, because SpellBook stores foil prices, sales and asks apart from nonfoil.

treatmentAsks.description: Pass the string 1 with finish=foil to read the selected printing’s special-treatment asks.

name: spellbook_card_desk
